title: Race condition in _join_key: membership updates without lock
description: groups_collection.py lines 716-729: _join_key modifies members and admins lists without holding _mutation_lock. Can race with rekey() which rebuilds these lists under the lock at lines 355-401. Result: legitimate member additions can be lost during concurrent rekey, causing authentication failures for newly joined members.
close_reason: _join_key wraps invitation check + roster append + burn marker in self.collection._mutation_lock and consumes via the unlocked helper (threading.Lock is non-reentrant: public consume_invitation inside the span would deadlock). Cross-thread rekey-vs-join test proves the membership append is never lost. tests/coap 1752 passed; ruff clean.
